summary: Retest for PIN auth feature + logout bug fix. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests pass (7 new PIN auth tests added: employee login OK/wrong, PIN 4-12 digit validation 422, /api/employees has no pin_hash, admin change-pin wrong-current 401, change-pin 1234->4321 roundtrip incl. restore, reset-employee-pin wrong-admin 401, reset-employee-pin roundtrip incl. restore). Frontend (Expo web, mobile 390x844): Logout bug FIXED — employee logout from Beranda AND admin logout from Persetujuan both return to role-select screen. Employee PIN flow: wrong PIN keeps user on PIN screen with toast, PIN 1234 signs in. Admin PIN: wrong 0000 stays on screen, 1234 signs in. Admin change-own-PIN dialog (pin-dialog with fields pin-field-current + pin-field-next) works: 1234->4321, verified login with 4321, restored to 1234. Admin reset-employee-PIN via Kelola > reset-pin-<id> (dialog uses single pin-field-pin) works: set 5678, verified employee login with 5678, restored to 1234. All admin/employee credentials restored to 1234 at end (confirmed via curl: admin_login=200, employee_login_1234=200).

issues: Logout button hanya ada di header tab Persetujuan; jika user di Laporan/Kelola dan ingin keluar harus balik dulu ke Persetujuan. Bukan bug (sesuai request), tapi consider consistent header/logout across admin tabs.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses bcrypt_sha256 (passlib) — good, avoids 72-byte truncation, timing-safe verify with DUMMY_HASH when hash missing.
Admin PIN bootstrap into settings/_id=auth is idempotent (only inserts if missing) — safe on redeploy.
employees list projection excludes _id and never returns pin_hash — verified by test.
PIN validation uses Pydantic field_validator with proper 4-12 digit rule; short PIN returns 422 not 400 (FastAPI/Pydantic default) — acceptable.
Frontend admin PIN stored in secure storage under key admin_pin; cleared on signOut (auth.tsx line 54) — correct.

Guard <Redirect href='/'> in employee/_layout.tsx & admin/_layout.tsx runs after ready && session.role !== 'employee'/'admin' — properly handles logout AND direct navigation without race with initial hydration.
Minor: xdist parallel test flakiness fixed by grouping admin change-pin roundtrip with admin login tests in same class (loadscope pins class to worker).
seed_data_creation: No new seed data added. During UI test, employee 303564ab-fa82-4380-97a5-7100a6d57ed7 PIN was temporarily 5678 then restored to 1234 via curl (verified 200/200). Admin PIN restored to 1234 via UI + verified 200.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin PIN=1234, all employees PIN=1234 (restored). Endpoints tested at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (23 tests). Pytest config: xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope — keep admin PIN roundtrip in TestAdminAuth class to avoid worker races. To run serially use `pytest -n 0`. Logout button testID=logout-button exists only on Beranda (employee) and Persetujuan (admin) headers.
rca_of_issue: Logout bug RCA (prior): signOut cleared session state but tabs remained mounted because there was no session guard in employee/_layout.tsx or admin/_layout.tsx; navigation stayed on the tab. Fix: both layouts add `if (ready && session?.role !== 'employee'/'admin') return <Redirect href='/' />` which unmounts tabs and sends user back to login when session becomes null. Verified end-to-end for both roles.
